title: sim/vehicle/v1
description: One sample of one simulated vehicle as the lab's MAVLink boundary (sim/mav_reader.py) or the runner's synthetic vehicle (internal/vehicle) reports it: one NDJSON line per GLOBAL_POSITION_INT. Lab-internal (docs/PLAN.md D2): the neutral line every Go simulator consumes; not part of the KT-2 aggregate and never sent to a system. Units are in the names (alt_amsl_m, speed_ms); positions WGS84 decimal degrees; ts is the vehicle's own UTC (SYSTEM_TIME), null until the vehicle has sent one (R-16). The MAVLink field each member comes from is the table in sim/mav_reader.py.

ts.description: The vehicle's UTC for the sample: GLOBAL_POSITION_INT.time_boot_ms on the SYSTEM_TIME clock, RFC 3339 with milliseconds and Z; null while the vehicle has sent no UTC.

time_boot_ms.description: GLOBAL_POSITION_INT.time_boot_ms: orders the samples of one vehicle run.

alt_hae_m.description: GPS_RAW_INT.alt_ellipsoid with a 3D fix, else null. SITL reports it equal to the AMSL altitude (no geoid), so it is not a HAE a bridge should broadcast (R-16).

alt_pressure_m.description: ISA pressure altitude from SCALED_PRESSURE.press_abs (1013.25 hPa); never AMSL.

fix_ok.description: GPS_RAW_INT.fix_type is at least a 3D fix.

alt_invalid.description: The geodetic altitude is to be broadcast as invalid (S-36, or no 3D fix).
